name: WDGG burnFrom without authorization burns the PancakeSwap pair reserve
summary: The WDGG implementation's burnFrom(from,value) debits any holder's balance with no allowance or caller check (and setWdgAddress lets anyone mark themselves fee-exempt). The attacker exempted its contract, bought 45.62 WDGG, burned 399,902.21 WDGG straight out of the WDGG/USDT pair, called sync() and sold the 45.62 WDGG for 40,008.28 USDT. Two later actors repeated the pair burn against newly added liquidity.

loss.notes: Per-campaign USDT depletion of the WDGG/USDT pair 0xc0b42a79928c9ab3f5fe424936f4241fdea53c30 net of the attacker's own USDT paid into it in the same transaction (4.575, 0.000000006861796509 and 0.01508886692637168 USDT). BSC-USD valued at par. The second and third campaigns are later actors against the same implementation (source-7).

ageReset.description: ProxyAdmin 0x1c429de906de3f1b9204eb9aacaf4b415b408fae upgradeAndCall (0x9623609d, empty data) by deployer 0xd72063c8 switched the WDGG proxy from 0xef121a21c01e90165800d31e360003c185aa650d to WDGG 0x512de7b4, the fifth and last implementation before the exploit.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age history. Verified WDGG implementation source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode chainid=56, 0x512de7b4, v0.8.24+commit.e11b9ed9, optimizer 200; SHA-256 of SourceCode 894376dacc4905de5661136de9f976921c200b9be2e3d69bc0d9e418b9c16187), file WDG/WDGG.sol: burnFrom(address from,uint256 value) only checks balanceOf[from] >= value, then debits it and emits Transfer(from,0); setWdgAddress(address) has no caller check and sets isExemptAddress for the new address. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 89481584, index 1, contract creation by EOA 0x467882f4c5f64fbc24de45762f8f5526700eb4af -> 0xb55d0364d912832deef66361b48d33f363eb4a8f): setWdgAddress(0xb55d0364) (0xc15623cf) via the proxy's delegatecall to 0x512de7b4; router buy of 45.620242901519689925 WDGG for 4.575 USDT (logs 4/6); burnFrom(pair, 399902.211705101846998562) (0x79cc6790, log 17 Transfer pair->0x0); pair.sync(); router sell of the 45.62 WDGG for 40008.279954926283836571 USDT (log 25). First exercise: eth_getLogs WDGG Transfer(to = 0x0) over blocks 89422460..89600000 returns four burns: 0x28b959422c7366fdacd189f4a00740e29ca453230495ead8f242508a36714304 (block 89446055) is the deployer/upgrader 0xd72063c8 burning 399,999.99999999994 WDGG from 0xf12cea7b4e9b2b2be64b1de5eea3b1b5af6dd1fa, the EOA that received the 10,000,000 WDGG initial mint and seeded the pair (project-controlled, no counterparty loss); then source-1 and the two later pair burns source-5/source-6. Age: EIP-1967 Upgraded logs on the proxy (eth_getLogs topic 0xbc7cd75a..., blocks 40000000..89481584) are five: 89422460 (0x4e950d6f, creation), 89435571 (0xa1406116), 89437084 (0xc6cc9128), 89438053 (0xef121a21) and source-2 (block 89445774, index 21, log 130, topic1 0x512de7b4). Implementation slot 0x3608...2bbc reads 0xef121a21 at 89445773 and 0x512de7b4 at 89445774 and 89481583. Implementation 0x512de7b4 was created top-level at block 89445588 (index 9, 0x01a0a1b741e4581a31d23a31bca0387bb0816dcf400f2fddb90b9f76a2368d6a, by 0xd72063c8); eth_getCode is 0x at 89445587 and its keccak256 is 0x51d67a93667784fe51b1b71640ae1975c2686a4136f4da41126bf09dc4ec6029 at 89445588 and 89481583. Proxy runtime keccak256 0x4d591a34a9a200b2a8e71445f03b6ecbdf4b3a21d435100e7f2bd27383d745ba at 89422460 and 89481583, empty at 89422459; the proxy is created top-level by 0xd72063c8 at 89422460 index 70. burnFrom depends on no configuration value, so the last upgrade supplies the age.
